prompt: Bright tropical midday on a tiny private island: white sand, turquoise shallows, a single leaning palm. Strung between the palm and a post, a striped hammock, and lying in it, fast asleep in the sun, a grey four-drawer steel office filing cabinet, the kind from a council archive, its top drawer slightly open with a fat folder labelled PROFITS peeking out. A pair of sunglasses rests on top of the cabinet, a cocktail with a paper umbrella in the sand beside it. Nobody else anywhere. Shot like a glossy travel-brochure photo, warm saturated colour, crisp sunlight, a deliberately sunny break from a cold grey film. Wide lens from low on the sand, the cabinet sharp in the middle of the frame, clear empty blue sky across the top third for on-screen text. Tall portrait frame.
